wire.text: Espanyol beat Athletic Bilbao 1-0.
Bayern held 1-1 by Koln.
Medvedev beats Tiafoe 6-3, 6-4 to reach ATP Finals semis.
NATO chief Rutte due in Warsaw today; Poland seeks more Eastern Sentry forces.

Boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsized Friday after mechanical failure; at least 4 killed, including 2 adults and 2 children.

Modi to open Nitish Setu today, India's longest Ganga bridge at 19.7km, ~Rs 4,280 crore.

Karnataka women win maiden national T20 title.
India U17 qualify unbeaten for AFC U17 Asian Cup 2027 after 0-0 with Malaysia.
Indian national Nikhil Gupta jailed 235 months in Pannun murder plot.
BepiColombo fires thrusters at 19:24 CET to enter Mercury orbit after 8 years, nearly 10bn km.
David Jones tells 1,689 staff their jobs end 30 Dec; 19 of 38 stores to close.
Trump threatens 'tremendous penalties' for US firms building data centres abroad.
Trump wants Ukraine peace deal by early January, FT reports.
Trump urges Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang; board says no.
SEC probing Nvidia's accounting practices, Reuters reports.
Anthropic falls 8.5% in its second trading session after its $107.3bn IPO (priced $83, opened $111.50 on 19 Nov, now ~$97) as the tech selloff continues.
EU pays Ukraine EUR 7.9bn, largest single Ukraine Facility disbursement.
UK, France and China believed to have blocked UAE's Lana Nusseibeh for UN chief in 9th straw poll.
